evidence.description: DateFormatter is instantiated inside the computed property.

candidates.explanation: The `localizedMonthAndYear` property creates a new `DateFormatter` instance every time it is accessed. This is an expensive operation and is considered a performance anti-pattern.
candidates.title: Expensive Object Creation in Property

evidence.description: The code uses JSONSerialization to get a dictionary and then JSONDecoder to decode a subset of that dictionary.

candidates.explanation: The `fetchAndUpdate` method uses `JSONSerialization` to parse the entire response into a dictionary before decoding the specific report. This is inefficient as it requires parsing the entire JSON structure into memory twice (once as a dictionary and once via JSONDecoder).
candidates.title: Inefficient Double Parsing

evidence.description: Public properties with internal setters on an actor allow synchronous access to internal state.

candidates.explanation: The `latestMonth` and `latestReport` properties are declared as `public internal(set)` on an `actor`. While actors protect state, these properties are accessible synchronously from outside the actor, which can lead to data races if accessed from multiple threads simultaneously, as the actor's isolation is bypassed by direct property access.
candidates.title: Actor Isolation Bypass
